title: Copy-on-write filesystem
summary: Breenix's copy-on-write filesystem reads, writes, commits atomically, checksums and scrubs, snapshots and recovers from crashes and power cuts without losing an acknowledged write, behind a filesystem interface ext2 also implements.

categories.title: Mounts and file operations through the filesystem interface
The shared buffer cache: verified misses, write groups and flush ordering
Formatter images pass the independent checker and violating images are refused
A host-built filesystem reads back as its manifest
File and directory operations commit through transactions
Space reservation: ENOSPC with nothing changed, freeing from the reserve
Host-enumerated crash images recover to an acknowledged commit
Corrupt data and nodes return EIO and never panic
Scrub finds and names corrupted blocks
Read-only snapshots, writable clones and resumable deletion
Every suite runs with the test root on the copy-on-write filesystem
Power cuts during commits lose no acknowledged write
The persistent install migrates from ext2 with equal manifests and rolls back
The ext2 partitions are reclaimed after two verified upgrades
